recruit.brief: Here's the real test: a 40 m hill, then 120 m of flat road. One gear has to do both. Guess which gear gets to the end first, then test them all.
recruit.question: Which gear will get to the end first?

cadet.brief: A hill, then a long flat road. Which gear gets there first? Guess, then try them all.
cadet.question: Which gear will get there first?

operative.brief: 40 m at 16.7°, then 120 m flat. Predict which gear ratio has the best total time, then test every ratio.
operative.question: Which gear ratio finishes first?
